prompt:

CRITICAL STRUCTURE-LOCK (non-negotiable, checked pixel-by-pixel against the original): every wall, pillar, archway, doorway, staircase, and prop must stay in EXACTLY its current position, size, and shape — do NOT move, add, remove, resize, or recompose ANYTHING; only the paint and lighting treatment changes. Keep the exact same isometric dimetric camera. Do NOT introduce any repeated, cloned, or tiled decorative motifs. Do NOT add any text, letters, numbers, labels, legends, map insets, UI elements, frames, or borders. Do NOT add any characters, people, figures, or creatures.
